description:
Unlocks the vertical axis for station building. A multi-layer station puts an elevated train platform over a bus platform at street level, as two separate stations in one structure - connect a road to the lower level and a track to the upper one.

KEEP THIS MOD ENABLED while a savegame contains any multi-layer station. The station is this mod, not a setting on a base-game one, so disabling the mod deletes every station you built with it and may leave the save unloadable. Bulldoze your multi-layer stations first if you want to remove the mod.

Beta: the supports and the concourse are deliberate placeholder blocks, and the station cannot be supported under the tile where your track leaves it.

ARTISTS AND MODDERS WELCOME. Every image and every block in this mod is a generated placeholder, and the menu previews say on their face which file and which format would replace them. The repository's README has the sizes, the formats and the volume each block has to fill, so nobody has to reverse-engineer anything to contribute art.

AI Disclaimer: Claude Code was used to create this mod.
name: Multi-layer Stations
summary: Build an elevated train station over a bus station.
